name: escalation-offline-recovery
objective: Close field escalation readback and durable offline recovery without unauthorized replay, lost evidence or false success.
truthOwner: DSH owns escalation and field mutation outcomes; Identity/Workforce own current authorization; app-field queue is transport/recovery state only.
journeys: field escalation and offline mutation recovery

tasks.objective: Close the field-authorized escalation lifecycle and operator decision/readback without inventing non-authoritative states.
tasks.currentProblem: Escalation creation/open-list behavior exists, while post-submission request-for-information/evidence/decision readback is not proven end to end.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace current escalation contracts/state machine and implement missing field-visible states/actions, operator support resolution and precise readback only where authority requires them.
tasks.targetState: The field actor can understand and perform every allowed escalation follow-up and sees operator decisions after refresh/restart.
tasks.action: Correct shared contract/controller/backend state first, then UI and operator readback; add scope/version/idempotency tests.
mustNotChange: Do not invent escalation states absent from current authority.
Do not expose another partner/store escalation.
Do not treat app-field local status as resolved truth.
acceptanceCriteria: All current field-authorized escalation actions/states are represented and permission-scoped.
Operator decision/request state reads back after refresh/restart.
Duplicate/stale escalation mutations are idempotent or conflict-safe.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix state inconsistencies; never weaken scope or audit.

tasks.objective: Complete field offline queue lifecycle, error classification and unknown-result/revocation recovery for supported mutations.
tasks.currentProblem: Current queue has scoped encrypted storage, idempotency/correlation and retry/backoff, but no explicit version/expiry/cancel/unknown-result model and retry classification is incomplete.
tasks.requiredChange: Add/prove schema version/migration, expiry/cancel where applicable, governed permanent-vs-retry classification, unknown-result lookup/reconciliation and server-side authorization revalidation.
tasks.targetState: Network loss, process death or later revocation cannot lose evidence, duplicate effects, replay unauthorized work or produce false success.
tasks.action: Change shared queue/sync policy and authoritative mutation/result APIs first; expand only operation types that current field UX truly supports offline; add deterministic tests.
mustNotChange: No offline queue becomes business truth.
No retry after authoritative forbidden/revoked outcome.
No blanket expansion of every field action to offline without Product Truth/UX need.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue schema/version/expiry and terminal outcomes are deterministic and recoverable.
Commit-response loss reconciles without duplicate effect or false failure/success.
Queued operation rejected after assignment/session revocation cannot later execute.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix durable queue schema; never downgrade stored data silently or disable authorization to replay work.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused offline/recovery commit with migration-compatible queue behavior.
